indexPrompt.cv-every-column-the-line-can-take: A 6 by 6 image holds a single vertical line, and the line could be in any of its six columns. For each column apply the vertical filter, ReLU and 2 by 2 max pooling, add up all 24 pooled values, and say which columns lose the line altogether and what change to the convolution would let the vertical filter find them.
